clue.text: Island's cold — month curtailed

parts.note: C is the tap abbreviation for cold

indicators.note: curtailed means cut short, so the month loses its final letter

parts.note: April is a month of the year

explanation.surface: Someone notes that an island is chilly because the month has been cut short.
explanation.definitionFit: Capri is an island in the Bay of Naples, off the Italian coast.

clue.text: Limitation to common foot complaint?

indicators.note: a limitation applied to the word cuts it short, so its last letter is lopped off

parts.note: corny means trite or hackneyed, so common in the sense of banal

explanation.surface: It asks whether a common foot ailment comes with some restriction.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Limitation to' trims CORNY (common, trite) at its end, dropping the Y.
explanation.definitionFit: A corn is a small patch of hardened skin on the toe, a frequent podiatric ailment.

clue.text: Security number supplied by idiots produces irritations

parts.note: a PIN is a personal identification number used for security
pricks is slang for fools

explanation.surface: A banking code supplied by fools ends up causing annoyance.
explanation.definitionFit: Pinpricks are small annoyances, minor troubles that nag at someone.

clue.text: Sports venue's one special viewing area hosting Republican

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one

indicators.note: hosting means holding a guest inside, so one piece goes within the other

parts.note: a box is a private enclosure for spectators at a theatre or stadium

explanation.surface: A stadium has a private box with a Republican guest in it.
explanation.walkthrough: Ibrox is the Glasgow stadium of Rangers football club; the 's stands for 'is'.
explanation.definitionFit: Ibrox Stadium in Glasgow is a football ground, home of Rangers.

clue.text: Three card players in lively 5, moving to upper level?

indicators.note: in means the players are placed inside the rearranged word
lively suggests energetic movement, so the letters are stirred into a new order

parts.note: the answer to 5-down, CASINO
E, N and S are East, North and South, three of the four players at bridge

explanation.surface: Three bridge players in a busy gambling hall seem to be going up in the world.
explanation.walkthrough: The '5' points to the answer of 5-down. In bridge the four seats are named after compass points, so three players can be three of those letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Ascension is the act of rising or climbing, going up to a higher position.

clue.text: Worrying and not initially soothing about Arabia

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the remainder goes around the abbreviation
not initially means the opening letter of the word is dropped

parts.note: calming means soothing
AR is an abbreviation for Arabia or Arabic

explanation.surface: Something disturbing and anything but reassuring is said about Arabia.
explanation.walkthrough: 'not initially' applies only to 'soothing', not to the whole phrase that follows.
explanation.definitionFit: Alarming means causing fear or anxiety, which is to say disturbing.

clue.text: Mostly planning to burgle old gambling venue

indicators.note: mostly means nearly all of the word, so its final letter is dropped

parts.note: casing a joint is slang for surveying it before a burglary

explanation.surface: Thieves are mainly scheming to rob an old gaming house.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Casing the joint' is criminal slang for scouting a place before a robbery.
explanation.definitionFit: A casino is a building where people bet on games of chance.

clue.text: King and scoundrel taken in by simple story

indicators.note: taken in by means held inside, so the pair goes within the other word

parts.note: naive means simple or unsophisticated
R is the abbreviation for rex, king
a rat is a scoundrel or traitor

explanation.surface: A monarch and a rogue are fooled by a simple tale.
explanation.definitionFit: A narrative is an account of connected events, a tale or story.

clue.text: I go out on time — or at the wrong moment?

parts.note: to nap is to doze off, to go out like a light briefly

explanation.surface: Someone confesses to dozing off on schedule, perhaps at an unsuitable time.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is loose, hence the question mark: something inapt is unsuitable, as an action at a bad moment would be.
explanation.definitionFit: Inapt means unsuitable or inappropriate, as an ill-timed remark would be.

clue.text: New Arab state left to probe content of desert, a waste region

parts.note: Oman is a sultanate on the Arabian Peninsula

indicators.note: to probe means to poke inside, so the letter goes into the other word

parts.note: sand is what a desert is made of

explanation.surface: A new Arab nation sends someone to explore the sand of a barren region.
explanation.definitionFit: No-man's-land is unoccupied ground between armies, or any desolate area nobody owns.

clue.text: Perhaps bypasses telephone and sticks around area

parts.note: to ring is to telephone

indicators.note: around means the sticks surround the abbreviation

parts.note: rods are sticks

explanation.surface: Someone perhaps skips the phone and pokes sticks about the place.
explanation.definitionFit: Ring roads circle a town to divert traffic from the centre, and a bypass is one example.

clue.text: Concrete motorway doing for the country

parts.note: concrete means real or actual, not abstract
M is the British road prefix for a motorway, as in the M1

explanation.surface: A concrete motorway is doing the job for the nation.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Concrete' looks like the building material but means tangible.
explanation.definitionFit: A realm is a kingdom or domain, so a country or territory.

clue.text: Negative mark appended to wine to make point

indicators.note: appended to means added to the end of, so the mark follows the wine

parts.note: a cru is a vineyard or wine of a recognized quality, as in grand cru
a cross, X, marks something wrong

explanation.surface: A critic adds a cross to a wine's entry to make a point.
explanation.definitionFit: The crux is the essential issue, the central thing under discussion.

clue.text: Bloke covering beat in part of New York

parts.note: a bloke is a man
a hat is a head covering
to tan someone's hide is to beat them

explanation.surface: A man is covering his patrol beat somewhere in New York.
explanation.walkthrough: 'covering' and 'beat' look like a policeman on patrol, but they are nouns and a verb giving HAT and TAN.
explanation.definitionFit: Manhattan is one of the five boroughs of New York City.

clue.text: Keep display facilities containing foremost of sports bags

parts.note: to have is to keep or hold

indicators.note: containing means the racks hold the letter inside

parts.note: racks are stands for displaying goods

indicators.note: foremost of means the first letter of the next word

parts.note: first letter of sports

explanation.surface: A shop holds on to its stands that show sports items, bags included.
explanation.definitionFit: Haversacks are canvas bags carried on the back or shoulder, like knapsacks.

clue.text: American's rotten luck with southern city

indicators.note: rotten means decayed or spoiled, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: and means with, joining things together

explanation.surface: An American bemoans bad fortune with a southern city.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rotten' rearranges LUCK to UCKL; 'southern' belongs with the definition, as the city is in the southern hemisphere.
explanation.definitionFit: Auckland is the largest city in New Zealand, far in the southern hemisphere.

clue.text: Superior Belgian city? Good grief!

parts.note: Liège is a city in eastern Belgium
Lord! is an exclamation of dismay, like good grief

explanation.surface: Someone exclaims in dismay about a Belgian city being thought better.
explanation.definitionFit: A liege lord is a feudal master to whom vassals owe allegiance, hence a superior.

clue.text: Bad opening to summer, distressing after father leaves

indicators.note: after means this piece comes behind the letter just found
opening to means the first letter of the next word

parts.note: first letter of summer

indicators.note: leaves means the father departs from the word, so those letters are removed

parts.note: painful means distressing
Pa is an informal word for father

explanation.surface: The start of summer was bad and upsetting once Dad left.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bad' at the start is the definition, not an anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Sinful means wicked or morally wrong, so bad in the ethical sense.

clue.text: Boy taken on by cloth worker as everyday employee

indicators.note: taken on by means taken inside, so the boy goes into the worker

parts.note: a fuller cleans and thickens woollen cloth
Tim is a boy's name

explanation.surface: A lad is hired by a textile worker as a regular member of staff.
explanation.definitionFit: A full-timer works the standard week, every working day rather than part-time.

clue.text: Came down on unknown figure supporting injunction making dull observation

indicators.note: in a down answer a supporting piece sits below, so the injunction comes first

parts.note: a ban is a prohibition or injunction

indicators.note: on means placed on top of, so in a down answer it comes first

parts.note: alit means landed, came down
Y is a mathematical unknown

explanation.surface: A judge's order landed on a mysterious person, making a trite remark.
explanation.definitionFit: A banality is a trite or commonplace remark, something boring and obvious.

clue.text: Religious festival brings attention about holy woman

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the attention goes around the saint

parts.note: to give someone your ear is to pay attention
Ste is the abbreviation for Sainte, a female saint in French

explanation.surface: A church feast draws notice to a female saint.
explanation.definitionFit: Easter is the Christian feast celebrating the resurrection of Christ.

clue.text: Strategy sees piano being encircled by exotic instrument

indicators.note: being encircled by means surrounded, so the letter goes inside the instrument

parts.note: a gamelan is an Indonesian percussion orchestra
P is the musical abbreviation for piano, quiet

explanation.surface: A tactic in which a piano is ringed by unusual instruments.
explanation.definitionFit: A game plan is a planned course of action, a set of tactics for success.

clue.text: Church study reduced large contribution to Harvest Festival?

parts.note: CE is the Church of England

indicators.note: reduced means cut down, so the final letter goes

parts.note: to read a subject is to study it

explanation.surface: A church's study of a large donation to its harvest thanksgiving.
explanation.walkthrough: 'reduced' cuts READ to REA. A Harvest Festival is a church service of thanksgiving for crops, where produce is donated.
explanation.definitionFit: Cereal crops such as wheat and barley are the grain gathered at harvest, typical donations.

clue.text: User began to change smaller groups

indicators.note: to change means the letters must be altered into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: A user started to switch to smaller groupings.
explanation.definitionFit: Subgenera are taxonomic ranks below a genus, subdivisions within a classification.

clue.text: Ditch game of skill for game of chance

parts.note: to bin something is to throw it away, ditch it
Go is a Japanese strategy board game

explanation.surface: Someone abandons a skill game in favour of gambling.
explanation.definitionFit: Bingo is a numbers game where winning depends purely on luck.

clue.text: Engineer once providing question on the radio

indicators.note: on the radio means heard rather than seen, so the word is sounded out

parts.note: what is a question word

explanation.surface: A former engineer gives an answer to a query broadcast on air.
explanation.walkthrough: James Watt was the 18th-century Scottish engineer who improved the steam engine.
explanation.definitionFit: James Watt was a Scottish inventor whose steam engine work drove the Industrial Revolution.

clue.text: Question from 24 across about European farm product

indicators.note: about means the question word surrounds the letter

parts.note: the question word that 24-across sounds like is what

explanation.surface: A query from the previous clue concerning a European crop.
explanation.definitionFit: Wheat is a cereal grown on farms for flour.

clue.text: River passing through excellent piece of ground

indicators.note: passing through means going inside, so the letter enters the other word

parts.note: ace means excellent

explanation.surface: A river flows across a fine stretch of land.
explanation.definitionFit: An acre is a unit of land area, used of a plot of land.

clue.text: Positive quantity of booze will be supplied by party

parts.note: a can of beer is a measure of drink
a do is a party or celebration

explanation.surface: Drink will be supplied by the party, which is good news.
explanation.definitionFit: A can-do attitude is optimistic and confident about getting things done.

clue.text: Doctor finally probing widespread disease of the skin

indicators.note: probing means poking inside, so the letter goes into the disease

parts.note: an epidemic is a disease that spreads widely

indicators.note: finally means the last letter of the word

parts.note: last letter of doctor

explanation.surface: A doctor's final act is to investigate a widespread skin ailment.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Doctor' looks like an anagram indicator, but only its last letter is used.
explanation.definitionFit: Epidermic is an adjective for the epidermis, the outer layer of skin.

clue.text: Special use of language? It's often cutting

parts.note: wordplay is the playful use of language

explanation.surface: A clever play on words is often biting, like sharp wit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cutting' seems to describe sarcastic wit, but it means blades cutting in fencing.
explanation.definitionFit: Swordplay is fencing, where blades slash and slice.

clue.text: Island about to enter into obligation

indicators.note: to enter into means going inside, so the short word goes within the obligation

parts.note: a tie is a binding obligation
re means about or concerning

explanation.surface: An island is about to make a commitment.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about to' looks like 'soon going to', but 'about' gives RE and 'to enter into' is the insertion. Tiree is an island in the Scottish Inner Hebrides.
explanation.definitionFit: Tiree is one of the Inner Hebrides, a small island off western Scotland.
